title: The 5 Best Free Keyword Research Tools in 2026 | Zapier

facts.fact: Zapier's author considered more than 90 tools with a free option for keyword research before selecting five for the roundup.
facts.quote: To help, I considered more than 90 tools with a free option for keyword research.

facts.fact: The article is titled 'The 5 best free keyword research tools in 2026' and was published on July 3, 2026.
Zapier's article says there are literally hundreds of tools purpose-built for keyword research.
facts.quote: There's no shortage of tools purpose-built for keyword research (literally hundreds of them)

facts.fact: Zapier states that its reviewers spend dozens of hours researching and testing each app in its best apps roundups, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
facts.quote: Unless explicitly stated, we spend dozens of hours researching and testing apps, using each app as it's intended to be used

facts.fact: Zapier states that all of the keyword research apps it selected include, at minimum, traffic, keyword difficulty, and competitive SERP analysis data.
facts.quote: All of the apps I selected include, at minimum, traffic, keyword difficulty, and competitive SERP analysis.

facts.fact: Zapier states that it only included free keyword tools with evergreen free plans, not time-limited trials, and that its selection excluded tools requiring paid add-ons.
facts.quote: I only included tools with evergreen free plans generous enough to actually be useful

facts.fact: Zapier's selection criteria require that a keyword tool work standalone without additional tools or extensions, especially paid ones.
facts.quote: your keyword tool should be a one-stop shop—without requiring any additional tools or extensions to work for you, especially not ones you'd have to pay for.

facts.fact: Zapier's article states that Zapier does not receive payment for placement in its articles and may earn a commission on some links.
facts.quote: We're never paid for placement in our articles from any app or for links to any site
